product.description: Buy fewer (and better) things. Store like with like. Get rid of the plastic. Display—don’t stash—your belongings. This compact tome shows us how  with more than 100 simple and stylish tips  each clearly presented and accompanied by full-color photographs that are sure to inspire. Readers will learn strategies for conquering their homes’ problem zones (from the medicine cabinet to the bedroom closet) and organizing tricks and tools that can be deployed in every room (embrace trays; hunt for unused spaces overhead; decant everything).
